residue.label: Cross-Bounded-Context composition remains undefined
residue.description: The first Context references one Governance Bounded Context. No composition rule yet explains how one Context preserves conflicts and owner boundaries across two or more Bounded Contexts.
residue.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 Language Project owner plus Context product owner
residue.next_action: Define a conflict-preserving composition rule only after one real Context must reference multiple Bounded Contexts.

residue.label: Composite Context deferred
residue.description: The first contract supports one primary Goal per Context. Cross-goal or cross-Project aggregation has no admitted identity, conflict, or lifecycle rule.
residue.next_action: Introduce a separate composite model only after a real consumer cannot remain bounded to one Goal.

residue.label: Correct consumer use remains unproven
residue.description: A valid Context or later resolved View does not prove that a human or agent interpreted or applied it correctly.
residue.owner_route: each consuming capability owner plus evidence owner
residue.next_action: Require downstream outputs to preserve Context and View identities, then test interpretation and use separately.
